picks.title: Chinese woman crashes SUV into motorcycle, killing Chon Buri girl
picks.memo: Chon Buri: Chinese woman driver's SUV hit a motorcycle carrying a family of three; 10-year-old girl died.

picks.title: Chinese woman says online date tricks her into abduction in Thailand
picks.memo: Chinese woman says online date with a Chinese man led to abduction; escaped by jumping from moving car.
